options.content: This dashboard is created based on this [data schema](https://devlake.apache.org/docs/DataModels/DevLakeDomainLayerSchema). Want to add more metrics? Please follow the [guide](https://devlake.apache.org/docs/Configuration/Dashboards/GrafanaUserGuide).

list.definition:
select distinct upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name
list.label: Project
list.name: project
list.query:
select distinct upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name

list.definition: SELECT concat(r.name, '--', r.id) as text FROM repos r JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = r.id AND pm.table = 'repos' WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project}))
list.label: Repo
list.name: repo_id
list.query: SELECT concat(r.name, '--', r.id) as text FROM repos r JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = r.id AND pm.table = 'repos' WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project}))

list.definition: select distinct author_name from pull_requests where base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) and author_name != '' and author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%' union select distinct assignee_name from issues i join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id join boards b on bi.board_id = b.id where b.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) and assignee_name != '' and assignee_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%' order by 1
list.label: Developer
list.name: developer
list.query: select distinct author_name from pull_requests where base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) and author_name != '' and author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%' union select distinct assignee_name from issues i join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id join boards b on bi.board_id = b.id where b.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) and assignee_name != '' and assignee_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%' order by 1
